name: Second Brain MVP Evaluation Dataset
description: Seven days of diary entries plus realistic calendar events for latency and retrieval quality evaluation.

seedDiaries.title: Monday kickoff and onboarding feedback
seedDiaries.content: Today I joined the capstone kickoff meeting with Tam, Quan, Duc Anh, Thang, and Nhan. We agreed that Tam will own AI memory retrieval, Quan will own backend APIs, Duc Anh will own the main frontend flow, Thang will own Google Calendar integration, and Nhan will own deployment and evaluation. My main feedback from mentor Linh was that the onboarding copy felt confusing and should be shortened before the demo. I need to create three realistic diary entries for testing tomorrow.

seedDiaries.title: API contract and upload discussion
seedDiaries.content: Quan and I reviewed the diary API contract. We decided that POST /diary should save the raw entry first, then trigger memory indexing. Thang suggested that attachments should keep extracted_text so PDFs can become searchable later. I finished the first draft of the upload response shape. My action item is to test attachment upload with one PDF and one plain text file.

seedDiaries.title: Search quality check
seedDiaries.content: Tam tested memory search with questions about feedback, decisions, and follow-up tasks. The retrieval found the right diary chunks, but the answer sometimes missed citations. We agreed to require every generated answer to return sources. Mentor Linh said the citation UI must be obvious so evaluators can trust the AI. I felt more confident after seeing hybrid retrieval work.

seedDiaries.title: Frontend timeline and search UI
seedDiaries.content: Duc Anh connected the diary input page to the backend API, and Nhan helped improve loading and empty states. The timeline now displays real diary entries instead of mock data. The search page can show an answer, confidence, and citation cards. We still need a summary page for daily and weekly reviews.

seedDiaries.title: Calendar sync and linking
seedDiaries.content: Thang synced Google Calendar events into the database and started the diary-to-calendar linking job. The calendar demo event was called Capstone Mentor Review. The linking logic matched events by date, keyword, and time proximity. We noticed that duplicate summaries could happen if the cron job runs twice, so idempotency should be checked later.

seedDiaries.title: Benchmark concern
seedDiaries.content: We discussed the 500ms memory recall requirement. The database retrieval may be fast enough with HNSW and GIN indexes, but full answer generation is slower because Gemini has to create the response. The plan is to measure embedding time, retrieval time, answer generation time, and total time separately. Streaming should be used for the demo so users see the answer sooner.

seedDiaries.title: Demo rehearsal
seedDiaries.content: The team rehearsed the demo scenario: create a diary entry, search for mentor feedback, ask about pending tasks, and open the weekly reflection. The strongest moment was showing citations for the onboarding feedback and the Capstone Mentor Review event. Remaining tasks are to seed one week of realistic data, fix the web font build issue, and prepare a short evaluation report.
